name: Browse the collection and open product enquiry
description: Verifies the main shopping path from the homepage into the catalogue and product enquiry action.
expected: The Shop page displays the product catalogue and the enquiry link opens a WhatsApp conversation for the selected item.

name: Use the baby essentials page on mobile
description: Verifies the baby category remains usable on a small viewport.
steps: Scroll through the baby product cards
expected: The baby page is readable on mobile, product cards are visible, and the enquiry action is available.

name: Contact the store
description: Verifies the contact page exposes the store address and communication channels.
steps: Review the store address and phone numbers
Select the WhatsApp or TikTok link
expected: The contact page shows the Port Harcourt address, both phone numbers, a WhatsApp action, and the supplied TikTok link.

name: Browse school kits and travel accessories
description: Verifies the school and travel section provides useful product imagery and an enquiry action.
steps: Review the school and travel section
expected: The page shows school/travel imagery and the enquiry action opens WhatsApp.
